## Change

Describe the completed behavior and why it is needed.

## Verification

Record commands, results and relevant native evidence.

## Compatibility acceptance

For a new or expanded compatibility implementation, name the complete module/API
unit and pinned Workers baseline. Keep the PR in draft until the
[acceptance gate](https://github.com/rdlabo-dev/capacitor-workers/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#acceptance-gate) is met.
For documentation-only or unrelated changes, mark this section not applicable.

- [ ] Export/API inventory has no unresolved coverage decisions.
- [ ] All required behavior is implemented; no project-specific exclusions or skipped contracts remain.
- [ ] Shared workerd/local contracts, Vite/esbuild, packed-consumer and iOS/Android verification pass.
- [ ] Required CI and manager/independent reviews pass.
- [ ] Implementation status and evidence are updated without claiming partial support as complete.
